_purpose: Functional scenarios (1 success + technique-driven alternative[]) per acceptance criterion for UC3. No unit tests. Executable-ready — feeds test cases / automation.
_status: phase-3-3 output — 2026-07-09. Derived from PDT-3564-uc3-complete-jira-story.json (AC+BR) + PDT-3564-uc3-test-design.md (L3 conditions).

_rules_applied.split_per_state: AC-03 has two valid outcomes (skip-back to 0:00 preserves prior play state) → SC-UC3-03a (playing) + SC-UC3-03b (paused).
_rules_applied.one_owner_per_br: BR-01→AC-06 · BR-04→AC-01 · BR-05→AC-03 · BR-08→AC-07 · BR-10→AC-05 · BR-12→AC-04 · BR-15→AC-10. Every other scenario cites (not re-tests) the rules it depends on. BR-05 owned once (start-clamp); AC-04 end-clamp / AC-08 mid-burst assert their own behaviour while citing BR-05 — no redundant re-test.

scenarios.title: Skip back moves playback exactly 10s (playing)
preconditions: a video / recorded LS is playing

expected.success: Playback jumps back exactly 10 seconds (1:00 → 0:50) and continues playing.
alternative: The skip moves by exactly 10s — not 9 or 11 (off-by-one guard).

scenarios.title: Skip forward moves playback exactly 10s (playing)
preconditions: a video / recorded LS is playing

expected.success: Playback jumps forward exactly 10 seconds (1:00 → 1:10) and continues playing.
alternative: The skip moves by exactly 10s — not 9 or 11 (off-by-one guard).

scenarios.title: Boundary skip-back to 0:00 while PLAYING preserves playback
preconditions: a video / recorded LS is playing
steps: Assert: playback continues from 0:00 (state stays playing)

expected.success: Position clamps to 0:00 and playback continues (prior PLAYING state preserved — a boundary skip-back does NOT force a pause).
alternative: A skip-back at exactly 0:00 stays at 0:00 — the position never resolves to a negative value.

scenarios.title: Boundary skip-back to 0:00 while PAUSED stays paused
preconditions: a video / recorded LS is paused

expected.success: Position clamps to 0:00 and the media stays paused (prior PAUSED state preserved — a boundary skip-back does NOT force a play).
alternative: A skip-back at exactly 0:00 stays at 0:00 — the position never resolves to a negative value.

scenarios.title: Boundary skip-forward past the end enters the end state
preconditions: a video / recorded LS (known length, e.g. 2:00)
steps: Assert: position clamps to the final frame (2:00)
Assert: the player is in the end state (paused at the final frame)

expected.success: Playback jumps to the final frame and enters the end state (paused at the final frame).
alternative: It does not loop back to 0:00.
It does not throw an error.

scenarios.title: Skip while paused updates position without resuming
steps: Tap either skip button while paused

expected.success: The position updates by ±10s and the video remains paused.
alternative: Skip never triggers an implicit paused → playing transition (no auto-resume).

scenarios.title: Live stream shows no in-app skip buttons
steps: Assert: the −10s / +10s buttons are NOT rendered

expected.success: On an active Live stream the ±10s skip buttons are not shown (seeking not applicable in-app).
alternative: On a recorded LS the ±10s skip buttons ARE shown.
On a video the ±10s skip buttons ARE shown.

scenarios.title: Rapid taps accumulate; icon shows the per-tap value
scenarios.automation_note: when-stable: web debounce→accumulate fix pending; mobile now
preconditions: a video / recorded LS is playing
steps: Assert: net position is 1:30 (each tap adds 10s — they accumulate)
Assert: the skip icon shows '+10' on every tap

expected.success: Three quick +10 taps accumulate to 1:30, and the icon shows the per-tap value (+10) each time.
alternative: The icon never shows the accumulated total (never '+30').

scenarios.title: Rapid taps near a boundary clamp mid-burst
scenarios.automation_note: when-stable: web accumulate fix pending; mobile now
preconditions: position near the start or end
steps: Assert: position goes 0:05 then clamps to 0:00 mid-burst (never negative)

expected.success: During a rapid burst near the start, taps accumulate until one would cross 0:00 — that tap clamps to 0:00, never negative, even mid-burst.
alternative: A rapid burst near the end stops at the final frame mid-burst and never loops back to 0:00.

scenarios.title: No skip buttons before the overlay is revealed
preconditions: a video / recorded LS is loaded
the UC1a controls overlay has not yet been revealed
steps: Assert: no skip buttons are visible

expected.success: No skip buttons are visible until the controls overlay is revealed (they appear only as part of UC1a's overlay).
alternative: After revealing the overlay (UC1a) the skip buttons appear (transition guard).

scenarios.title: Skip while buffering (mobile) seeks and rebuffers
preconditions: the video is buffering at the current position
steps: Mock: throttle the network to force buffering
Assert: the player seeks to the target and rebuffers there (explicit loading), then resumes — no stuck spinner, no crash

expected.success: On mobile, tapping a skip button while buffering seeks to the target and rebuffers there — surfacing loading feedback, never a silent frozen frame.
alternative: The viewer is never left on a frozen frame with no feedback.

scenarios.title: Skip while buffering (web) — behaviour unconfirmed
preconditions: the video is buffering at the current position
steps: Assert: the 'Reconnecting' UI is shown and manual scrub/scroll remains available
Observe and record the outcome (do NOT assert until FU-3 closes)

expected.success: The web player surfaces the 'Reconnecting' UI and keeps manual scrub/scroll available — the viewer is never left on a silent frozen frame (BR-15).
alternative: The exact ±10s-skip result mid-buffer on web is UNCONFIRMED — observed and recorded, not asserted, until FU-3 closes.

pending.note: observe/record only; do not assert the skip-tap result until Web Engineering confirms (FU-3).
